referenceScan.method: Exact decoded scalar match to short map name, full package or World object path; distinguishes NameMap, own package identity, bytecode, import, serialized values and soft objects. Native binary computed names and runtime-generated strings not covered.

limitations: Package names containing Test are not proof of unused or editor-only status.
Direct LoadStreamLevel calls prove compiled requests only; branch reachability and successful dynamic registration/loading remain unknown.
Blueprint-inherited meshes absent from map component properties are not counted as explicit mesh references.
No changes to world-coverage.json denominators or demo assets/source.
